help.title: How top-ups work
help.step1: The driver registers their Binance Pay ID in the app.
help.step2: They send USDT through Binance Pay to Pay ID {payId} ({name}). Minimum top-up: {min}.
help.step2Missing: They send USDT through Binance Pay to the Kuulis account. No Pay ID is configured yet: drivers cannot top up until you add it in
help.step3: In the app they notify the payment (with the order ID, if they have it); the notice shows up here as pending.
help.automatic: Automatic reconciliation is on: every minute the Binance Pay history is checked and each USDT payment whose payer matches a driver's Pay ID is credited. Payments that match nobody stay as "Unmatched" to be assigned by hand.
help.manual: Manual reconciliation: the server has no Binance credentials, so each pending notice is credited here after checking the payment in Binance.
help.unknownMode: If the server has Binance credentials, payments are credited automatically when the payer's Pay ID matches a driver's, and the rest stay "Unmatched". Without them, each pending notice is credited here by hand after checking it in Binance.
help.statuses: Crediting a top-up closes the driver's oldest pending notice and retries any pending fee.

transfers.help: Balance sent between drivers. Limit per driver: {limit} sent per month.

totals.waivedHelp: Due to low earnings, the free period or an admin decision.

resolve.visibleHelp: The answer is sent as a notification to the reporter and stays visible on their report. Do not include internal notes or the other person's details.

help.title: How to reconcile against the Binance statement
help.step1: Pick the same period as the Binance Pay statement (dates are Caracas time; Binance shows UTC, so check movements near midnight).
help.step2: What Binance received in the period must match "Top-ups credited". Download the top-ups CSV (status credited) and compare each order by its transaction or reference.
help.step3: A payment in Binance but not in the CSV is usually "unmatched" or "pending": resolve it in Top-ups. One in the CSV but not in Binance is a manual confirmation to review.
help.step4: To check balances use the entries CSV: each row has the balance after the movement.
help.balances: "Wallet balances" does not depend on the period: it is what drivers hold in Kuulis today, the money Kuulis owes them in service.

cards.feesPendingHelp: Pending fees do not depend on the period
cards.promoCreditsHelp: What Kuulis credited to drivers for discounts.
cards.transfersHelp: They do not change the wallet total
cards.walletBalancesHelp: Sum of every balance right now: what Kuulis "owes" in service. It should be backed by what is in the Binance account.

team.name: Name

invite.noToken: The link is incomplete. Ask for a new invitation.

approvals.held: Sent for approval: someone else has to approve it

legal.help: Legal texts users see in the app. Each version is published in Spanish and English. If it requires accepting again, nobody can request or accept rides until they accept it. The current drafts are pending a lawyer's review.

who.community: Linked from the terms; not accepted separately.

legal.publishHelp: Published as the next version in both languages. Earlier versions are kept.
legal.summaryHelp: Users see it on the "We updated our terms" screen.
legal.reacceptHelp: Use it for important changes. Minor changes (typos, clarifications) do not need it.
legal.noAcceptances: Has not accepted any text yet.

privacy.deletionsHelp: Accounts whose owner asked to delete them. For 30 days they can get it back by signing in; then their personal data is erased and their rides and payments stay without a name.

privacy.userErased: Account deleted on {date}: its personal data is already erased.
privacy.userScheduledHelp: Asked for on {date}. Signing in to the app before then restores the account.

versions.help: Versions of the Android app (APK) offered to users. The app and the website offer the newest version of their channel that is not withdrawn. Withdrawing a version offers the previous one again; marking it mandatory stops older builds from requesting or accepting rides until they update.
versions.buildsHelp: APKs the compiler uploaded for this environment, newest first.
versions.usageHelp: Distinct people who used each build in the last 7 days.
versions.publishHelp: The app and the website will offer this build to whoever uses the chosen channel.
versions.channelHelp: QA: testing team. Beta: invited testers. Production: every user.
versions.notesHelp: What changed. Users see it when updating.
versions.mandatoryHelp: People on an older build of this channel will not be able to request or accept rides until they update. Use it only for critical fixes or incompatible changes.
versions.confirmMandatory: People on an older build in the {channel} channel will not be able to request or accept rides until they update to this version.
versions.confirmOptional: Older builds can be used again, unless another mandatory version blocks them.
versions.confirmWithdraw: It stops being offered in the {channel} channel: the previous version is offered again. People who already installed it keep it. If it was mandatory, it stops blocking older builds.
versions.confirmRestore: It is offered again in the {channel} channel (if it is the newest build) and, if mandatory, blocks older builds again.

ota.title: JavaScript updates (OTA)
ota.help: Changes to the JavaScript code that arrive without installing a new APK. Only apps built with the same native code (runtime) receive them. The app downloads them in the background and applies them the next time it is opened, never in the middle of a ride. The percentage picks a stable share of devices: the same phone is always in or out.
ota.candidatesHelp: JavaScript bundles the compiler uploaded for this environment, newest first.
ota.usageHelp: Distinct people who used each update in the last 7 days.
ota.publishHelp: Apps in the chosen channel with the same runtime will download it and apply it when they are opened again.
ota.rolloutHelp: Start small (10 %) to test and widen once everything looks fine. 0 % leaves it paused.
ota.confirmPause: It stops reaching new devices in the {channel} channel. Devices that already downloaded it keep it.
ota.confirmFull: It will reach every app in the {channel} channel with the same runtime.
ota.confirmRevert: It is withdrawn in the {channel} channel and the apps receive a newer copy of the previous update that was at 100 % or, if there is none, go back to the APK's code. The change applies the next time the app is opened.
